entities.summary: Eugen Carpov is a diplomat and politician from Moldova. He was the Deputy Prime Minister for Reintegration of the Republic of Moldova from 14 January 2011 to 10 December 2014. Eugen Carpov was a political leaders from Ungheni (b. 1966-04-22, Ungheni). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
